description: This file contains utility functions for managing exam environments, including exam generation, validation, scoring, and attempt construction, with integrations to Prisma ORM, Fastify framework, and various exam-related data structures.

methods.name: checkPrerequisites
methods.description: Checks if user has met all prerequisites for an exam, including honesty and completed challenges.

methods.name: constructUserExam
methods.description: Creates a user-facing exam object from generated and original exam data, including shuffling answers and ordering question sets.

methods.name: validateAttempt
methods.description: Validates that all questions and answers in an attempt are from the generated exam.

methods.name: checkAttemptAgainstGeneratedExam
methods.description: Verifies that the attempt's question sets and questions match those in the generated exam, including answer inclusion.

methods.name: userAttemptToDatabaseAttemptQuestionSets
methods.description: Updates question sets with submission times if answers have changed during user attempt.

methods.name: generateExam
methods.description: Generates a randomized exam based on configuration, shuffling questions and answers, and fulfilling tag and question count constraints.

methods.name: calculateScore
methods.description: Calculates the percentage score of an attempt based on correct answers.

methods.name: compareAnswers
methods.description: Compares user answers with correct answers to determine correctness.

methods.name: isQuestionSetConfigFulfilled
methods.description: Checks if a question set configuration has been fulfilled with the required number of question sets and questions.

methods.name: getRandomAnswers
methods.description: Selects a specified number of correct and incorrect answers randomly for a question.

methods.name: shuffleArray
methods.description: Shuffles an array using Fisher-Yates algorithm.

methods.name: constructEnvExamAttempt
methods.description: Constructs the exam attempt object with result and status, handling expiration and moderation states.
